name: Set rules of engagement
summary: Change the named unit's automatic-engagement policy to Weapons Free, Tight or Hold.
requirements: Requires own-unit information and a unit accepting player orders. Does not propagate to formation members.
execution_note: Changes only the named unit's rules of engagement. Existing attack orders and all waypoint reservations remain. Hold does not cancel explicit attacks or guarantee that CIWS self-defense stops. Use Cancel attack as well when attack cancellation is needed.
